name: sol_basics_ac_2
description: Missing access control on sensitive privileged functions
question: The source file in `source` defines a function that performs a sensitive, privileged action (such as changing ownership, withdrawing or transferring funds, minting tokens, upgrading contract logic, or modifying critical configuration) without any caller-restriction check (e.g. onlyOwner, role-based modifier, or explicit require on msg.sender), allowing any external caller to invoke it and alter state or drain assets, excluding functions that are intentionally public/permissionless by design (e.g. deposit, public view functions) or that already enforce an owner/role/allowlist check.
criteria: withdraw(address to, uint256 amount) transfers contract ETH or tokens to an arbitrary address with no onlyOwner or role check
setOwner(address newOwner) or transferOwnership overwrites the owner variable with no check that msg.sender is the current owner
mint(address to, uint256 amount) creates new tokens callable by any external address with no access restriction
upgradeTo(address newImplementation) changes the contract's implementation address without verifying msg.sender is an authorized admin
setFeeRecipient or setConfig updates critical protocol parameters with no modifier or require restricting the caller
